about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: OUR STORY
about.heading: Meticulous Quality, Custom-Engineered Weaving
about.body: With 40 years rooted in Taiwan, we focus on high-quality weaving and custom service. Drawing on decades of hands-on experience, we recommend the right materials and structures for your actual use case, and can handle printing, sewing, and other finishing in-house — saving you the hassle of coordinating multiple vendors.

customization.title: Customization Services
customization.subtitle: TAILORED FOR YOU
customization.specsBody1: Choose from a wide range of materials — polyester, nylon, pure cotton, and various performance yarns.
customization.specsBody2: Color, material, dimensions, thickness, elasticity, and core filling can all be highly customized to your needs.
customization.finishingBody1: We handle a full range of finishing work for webbing.
customization.finishingBody2: Including heat-transfer printing, plate printing, custom-length cutting, tipping, and more.
customization.unsureTitle: Not Sure About Materials or Methods?
customization.unsureBody1: No problem — just reach out to us directly.
customization.unsureBody2: Tell us your intended use and requirements, and we'll recommend the best approach, suitable materials, and a fair quote.
